content: Omwendisi No Kwasepahala
Jesu sebeli wamba kame kwa iyetwa nji, “Kame kuna kwikala omulume no kufuma ona kwikala ni mubika waye. Cwale epiho sebeli iiya kwa yonyene nji omunu woyo kame ana kusinya esifumu saye,
mi sebeli omwisana ni kwamba kwa yonyene nji, ‘Iikene eyi niyupa mulibaka lyowe? Otunde ba sipula sowe no ubika kakuli kufanene okutenda omubika wange.’
Cwale omubika sebeli okwambisa yomboci nji, ‘Iikene sani tende kakuli molyange nani tundisa ba ubika? Songolile onene okutombola mi kame neena okukumbela.
Kame niyii esi sanitende! Nji cwale aanu ani tambule mu tindoo too aba ina tundu ba musebezi wange.’
Cwale sebeli oisana awo ana kukolotela molyaye omunjili ni munjili. Sebeli oibanguta woyo no weli nji, ‘Bukai ona kolotele molyange?’
Sebeli otambula nji, ‘Omwanda no sipimo no oli,’ cwale sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, ‘Oshimbe esikoloti sowe mi oikale banji muwangu on̄ole nji makumi atanu 50.’
Cwale sebeli wamba ku munjili nji, ‘Bukai ona koloto?’ Sebeli wamba nji, ‘Masaka akwana omwanda no uloto,’ Sebeli omwambela nji, ‘Oitundise mi on̄ole makumi atanu naatu (80).’
Molyaye sebeli onyaza omubika mulibaka no kwasepahala kwaye kakuli aanu no litunga lino kame amonahala okutenda wino eyi no lusika loo feela okubita aanu no liseli.
Cwale kame nimyambela nji, “Mukutende oulikani mwenyene mulibaka no kwaluka, nji cwale aba sai kwangwe kame samitambule mu mundi no kuta oku no kwaabwa.
Woyo no kusepahala kweyi no kucaniba mba sepahala kweyi no kupula, mi woyo no kwasepahala kweyi no kucaniba katamba kusepahala ngeeso kweyi no kupula.
Nji cwale kamusi sepahala mu inu no kwaluka, anyine so misepa mu ufumu no niti?
Cwale nji kamusi sepahala mu sinu no mukowe, anyine sokuba eso sili senu?
Kakwisa omubika otwesa okusebeleza ambumu ayiili, kakuli mbu timbibo mumweya ni kusingabo munjili simba oukubeeka onene kumumweya ni kukana omunjili. Kutwese okusebeleza Nyambe ni mali.”
Emyambelo Injili ya Jesu
Afalisi awo ana kusinganga amali aba ana kuyupa eyi, cwale sebeli atimba Jesu.
Kono Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Anyi mukuyeema mwenyene balubala no aanu, kono Nyambe kame ayii emicima yenu kakuli eyo itendile eyi no utokwa mukaci no aanu akwiiba mu miyo ya Nyambe.
“Omulawo na nuhi konji ba nako ya Jowani okutunda abo cwale eliywi no kuwaba no mubuso wa Nyambe aba lina kukutaziwa, mi omunu yonje sebeli weteka onene okwingenamo.
Kono kwakotoba eliwilu ni litunga nji ibwe okubita enombolo imweya no mulawo nji ibwe.
“Munu yonje woyo olukulula mukataye ni kukwata omunjili kame abuka mane ni woyo okwata omukati ona lukululwa kwa mbumwaye kame abuka.
Omulume no Kufuma ni Lazalo
“Kame kuna kwikalanga omulume no kufuma ona kukumanganga eikumango no undilu ona kulyanga eilya no kuwaba ba liywaa ni liywaa.
Cwale ba mweelo waye kame kuna kulangananga omulume no kusheba no litina lya Lazalo ona kwikalanga ni itombo olutu lonje,
woyo ona kulakazanga okulya eyo ina kukwanga ku tafule no mulume no kufuma, cwale ambwa sebeli aiya ni kulasa ba itombo yaye.
Omulume no kusheba sebeli ofa mi amangeloi sebeli amushimbela kwa Abulahama mu saali saye. Omulume no mufumi ni yonyene sebeli ofa mane sebeli oteuliwa,
mi mu lyangalilo, yoli mu mayando sebeli waliketa ni kumona Abulahama aba no kuleba mane Lazalo yoli mu saali saye.
Cwale sebeli okuwa nji, ‘Sitange Abulahama! Onifele amakeke, mi otume Lazalo acupwe amamaneneno no munwe waye mu meyi nji aombote olulimi lwange, kakuli kame nili mu utata onene muno mu mulilo!’

Kono Abulahama sebeli omutambula nji, ‘Mwanange opuluke nji mu nako no kuyoya kowe nukutambulanga einu no kuwaba, mi Lazalo kasi kwikalanga ni inu no kuwaba. Kono bano kame ali wino kuno, mi wene kame oli mu utata.
Cwale okwekeza kweeyi, mukaci ketu ni wene kame kuli owina no kuneneba onene, nji cwale awo ali muno katwese okwiiya kwa wene mane kakwisa woyo sotwesa okuta okutunda omo okwiiya kwaaci.’
Cwale omufumi sebeli wamba kwa Abulahama nji, ‘Kame ni kukumbela, sitange, otume Lazalo ku ndoo ya sitange,
kakuli kame nikwite ainange atanu nji cwale akaalemuse nji alese okwiiya mu sibaka sino no mayando.’
Kono Abulahama sebeli wamba nji, ‘Kame akwite Mushe na nuhi a Nyambe cwale walesele aayupe.’
Cwale omufumi sebeli wamba nji, ‘Kokuulwa, sitange Abulahama! Kono nji kute omunjili kwa onyene ona tundu kwaafu, mba baka.’
Cwale Abulahama sebeli wambela omufumi nji, ‘Nji katamba okuyupa Mushe na nuhi a Nyambe, katamba okuyupa simba woyo soingulwa okutunda kwaafu.’”
